{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hadde-Rishun Road''' was a road on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] used it to move supplies from the port [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rishun]] to their [[Hadde Base|base]] in [[Hadde]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
